summary: Clear every failing readiness check on this repository's chain by records written through the CLI (the operator answering the two D1 questions), and end the explicit-id bundling workaround (WA-08) at the 0.37.0 release. FBS-241's round DEFINE records the freeze (GR-31).
approach: A chain-authoring round: the DEFINE stage (test-author) writes the records check by check, driven by node bin/rcf.js define readiness --check <stage> output; BUILD is expected to be empty unless a check is shown wrong for a CLI product, in which case its fix is a new criterion with an ADR first. The stage-keeper records the freeze after D1 to D6 pass.
deliverables: Chain records: REQ shape classifications, TAD data and security architecture, a Deploy target ADR, TAC interfaces and settled drafts, failure and must-not criteria or reasoned defineD4 opt-outs, closed sets, concern-ledger entries, recordShape fields, ownerRefs (test-author)
The operator's D1 profile answers, recorded by the shipped write-back
notes: DEFINE part A, 2026-10-24 (test-author). Readiness at START: exit 4, chips D1-D6 and D8 failing, about 900 findings (readiness-start output, summarised in ADR ADR-4160). Flags: US tags (WORKAROUND, ADR ADR-4152); every criterion here is testOnly. DEFINE part B3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 8): this slice's round DEFINE commits the named readiness fixture trees under test/fixtures/readiness/ (clean, d0-discovery, d1-brief, d2-skeleton, d3-shapes, d4-stories, d5-crosscut, d6-consistency, d7-decisions and d8-freeze: a clean tree plus one tree built to fail each D-check, D0 to D8) and captures the chip golden test/fixtures/readiness/chips.json, as { "<tree>": "<its Chips line>" }, from the round-base bin, from packages/rcf-lite, with node test/_harness/goldens.js readiness-chips test/fixtures/readiness/chips.json, which the AC-20301-4 test compares with the Chips lines at HEAD. DEFINE part B3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 9): this slice's round DEFINE records the operator's GR-55 answers of 2026-10-24, surface "the running app" and register "product owner", in rcf/.identity/profile.md by the shipped write-back (an edit of that file, its Surface section reading runningApp and its Register section reading productOwner, with no other surface or register marker word in the file, since the AC-20303-1 test reads one whole-word marker per question), naming the operator and that date as their source, which the AC-20303-1 test reads, and the sources are the ledger entries the AC-20303-3 test reads. DEFINE part C, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling on part B3's open question 1, reading a): this slice's round DEFINE records the own-chain golden test/fixtures/own-chain/at-639f07bb.json, as { "rev", "notApplicableStages", "liveCriteria" } (the stages node bin/rcf.js define readiness --json reports notApplicable over 639f07bb's chain with 639f07bb's own bin, and the description, given, when and then of every criterion live at 639f07bb, by id), from a full clone, from packages/rcf-lite, with node test/_harness/goldens.js own-chain test/fixtures/own-chain/at-639f07bb.json, before BUILD (its values are 639f07bb's, so the moment in the round does not change them), which the AC-20301-4 own-chain half and the AC-20302-3 test compare against. DEFINE part C, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling C4 on the independent check, from GR-54): this slice's round DEFINE reclassifies REQ-196, REQ-198 and REQ-204 first (the 14 concern pairs may be scan artefacts). DEFINE part C3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 3 on part C2's stop): this slice's BUILD delivers the shared profile reader AC-20303-4 names, one reader in src/ that the D1 brief:profile check, rcf define readiness, the viewer, rcf define questions and the MCP tool all resolve profile:surface and profile:register through. DEFINE part C3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 3 on part C2's stop): this slice's round DEFINE mints the two operator source entries for rcf-lite's own profile, one per key, with the profile and before the AC-20303-3 marker drops, in the form the AC-20303-3 test reads at HEAD (a question containing "the value of profile:surface" or "the value of profile:register", two or more options so D7 decisions:wellFormed passes, and an answer opening "The operator, 2026-10-24:" followed by the operator's GR-55 answer quoted verbatim), from packages/rcf-lite with node bin/rcf.js define ledger decisions add --question "(rcf-lite 0.37.0 DEFINE) What is the value of profile:surface in rcf-lite's own profile, rcf/.identity/profile.md? Source: the operator's GR-55 answer, 2026-10-24." --option "a:viewer" --option "b:runningApp" --option "c:prDiff" --default c --blocks FBS-240, then node bin/rcf.js define ledger decisions resolve <the minted id> --answer 'The operator, 2026-10-24: "the running app"', and node bin/rcf.js define ledger decisions add --question "(rcf-lite 0.37.0 DEFINE) What is the value of profile:register in rcf-lite's own profile, rcf/.identity/profile.md? Source: the operator's GR-55 answer, 2026-10-24." --option "a:productOwner" --option "b:engineer" --option "c:unstated" --default c --blocks FBS-240, then node bin/rcf.js define ledger decisions resolve <the minted id> --answer 'The operator, 2026-10-24: "product owner"'.
title: Readiness D1 to D6 and D8 green on rcf-lite main: frozen --next is the default again once FBS-241's round DEFINE records the freeze (GR-31)
